Long, flowing platinum white hair with a straight parting and sleek texture. Sharp, narrow amethyst purple eyes with a stoic expression. Apparent age of a young adult with a refined, mature face. Slender, graceful build. A high-contrast black and crimson gothic dress with intricate gold embroidery and a wide collar. A long, slender demonic tail and curved black horns protruding from the forehead.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
